columns.name: TPSA
columns.definition: Topological polar surface area (A^2), Ertl method

columns.name: NumRotatableBonds
columns.definition: Number of rotatable bonds (RDKit strict definition)

definitions.name: Aromatic nitro group
definitions.rationale: Redox cycling and, on an acidic ring, protonophoric uncoupling.

definitions.name: Nitrophenol (phenol + aromatic nitro)
definitions.rationale: Classic protonophoric uncoupler pharmacophore: an acidic, lipophilic, delocalised anion that shuttles protons across the inner membrane (the DNP archetype).

definitions.name: Halogenated phenol
definitions.rationale: Halogens lower phenol pKa and raise logP - the two properties that make a weak acid an effective uncoupler.

definitions.name: para-Quinone
definitions.rationale: Redox cycling with the respiratory chain; superoxide generation.

definitions.name: ortho-Quinone
definitions.rationale: Redox cycling; also a strong electrophile.

definitions.name: Sterically hindered phenol (BHT-like)
definitions.rationale: Lipophilic antioxidant phenols reported to perturb respiration; the BHT/BHA structural family, directly relevant to food additives.

definitions.name: Epoxide
definitions.rationale: Strained electrophile; protein and DNA alkylation.

definitions.name: Aromatic azo
definitions.rationale: Azo dyes; reductive cleavage yields aromatic amines. Common among colour additives.

definitions.name: Biguanide
definitions.rationale:
Complex I inhibition (metformin/phenformin class). Bond orders are
          left unspecified because the biguanide tautomer drawn varies between
          depositors; ring atoms are excluded so triazines such as melamine do
          not match.

definitions.name: Dithiocarbamate
definitions.rationale: Metal chelation and thiol reactivity. Flagged specifically because salt stripping merges the metal complexes with their alkali salts in this dataset (see flag_metal_removed).
